counties.notes: Hinds County (Jackson, pop. 231,000; state capital) parcel layer hosted on MDEQ OPCGIS server. Mississippi DEQ hosts parcel layers for many MS counties under the 'Government' folder on opcgis.deq.state.ms.us. The layer publishes 54 fields: OBJECTID, CAMA, PARNO, ALTPARNO, PPIN, OWNNAME, MAILADD1/2, MCITY1/2, MSTATE1/2, MZIP1/2, SITEADD, SCITY, SSTATE, SZIP, SUBNAME, deed and plat references, assessed values, acreage, ZONING, LEGLDESC and geometry measures. OWNNAME field returns owner name in mixed format. Verified 2026-05-15: SMITH returns Jackson MS site addresses. The same server also has DeSoto County parcels and other MS county datasets. 2026-09-26: the layer now refuses any query that names its outFields (HTTP 200 carrying error 400 "Failed to execute query.", measured twice each on the enrichment, radius and liveness query shapes) and answers outFields=* with 54 fields, so every UrbanKit query to this service sends outFields=* and the sample query above does the same. Measured the same day with returnCountOnly: MAILADD1, MAILADD2, MCITY1, MSTATE1 and MZIP1 are blank on every one of the layer's 114,814 parcels (0 rows each where the column IS NOT NULL AND <> '', against 114,547 for OWNNAME and 114,514 for SITEADD), so the record lists no mailing field and this county serves owner names and site addresses, not mailing addresses. On 2026-10-13 we added a second endpoint: the MARIS/MDEQ 2024 statewide West layer (MS_MDEQPARCELS_West_2024 MapServer layer 0 on gis.mississippi.edu, 878,999 parcels across 38 western counties) scoped with STCNTYFIPS = '28049', the 2024 roll with 114,935 parcels, 121 more than the primary's 114,814 and three years fresher than the primary's TAXYEAR 2021; the second endpoint is a fallback. OWNNAME and SITEADD are each filled on 99.9% of its rows. MAILADD1 is empty on every row there as well (0 of 114,935), so neither endpoint lists a mailing field. The primary stays first because it pages. The statewide layer refuses pagination (any resultRecordCount or resultOffset returns HTTP 200 with error 400 "Pagination is not supported.") and answers at most 2,000 rows per request. A FID equality or a read scoped by FIPS plus a FID range answers in 70 to 550 ms; a PARNO equality or any other non-FID predicate scans the whole layer and takes 1.3 s to more than 20 s, more on the first query after hours idle. The server rejects FID BETWEEN (HTTP 200 with error 400 "Failed to execute query."); write the range as FID >= a AND FID <= b. CORS measured 2026-10-13 with an Origin header: the OPCGIS primary answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://urbankitstudio.com, and the statewide layer echoes any Origin, so both are browser-callable.

Owner names and site addresses are populated on both.

counties.notes: Adams County, Mississippi (FIPS 28001). Served by the MARIS/MDEQ 2024 statewide cadastral layer (West half, MS_MDEQPARCELS_West_2024 MapServer layer 0 on gis.mississippi.edu), compiled from the county tax assessors' rolls and republished by MARIS; credit the Adams County Tax Assessor's office and MARIS/MDEQ. The layer carries all 38 western counties (878,999 parcels), so every attribute search here is scoped with STCNTYFIPS = '28001' (18,558 parcels read 2026-10-12). Informational only and not a legal record: verify with the Adams County Tax Assessor, whose roll is the authoritative source. The layer refuses pagination (any resultRecordCount or resultOffset returns HTTP 200 with error 400 "Pagination is not supported.") and answers at most 2,000 rows per request, setting exceededTransferLimit on a cut; orderByFields and returnDistinctValues are ignored without an error, outStatistics fails, and returnCountOnly, returnIdsOnly and objectIds work. A FID equality or a read scoped by FIPS plus a FID range answers in 70 to 550 ms, and a count over a FIPS-plus-FID range in about 1.1 s. A PARNO equality or any other non-FID predicate scans the whole statewide layer and takes 1.3 s to more than 20 s, more on the first query after hours idle, so scope anything else with STCNTYFIPS plus a FID range or objectIds. The server rejects FID BETWEEN (HTTP 200 with error 400 "Failed to execute query."); write the range as FID >= a AND FID <= b. OWNNAME and SITEADD are each filled on 98.1% of rows (18,204), with SCITY, SSTATE and SZIP beside them. Across the statewide layer SITEADD carries the vacant-land placeholders '0' and '0 <STREET>' on some rows (about 48% in Hancock, 26% in Lamar, 11% in DeSoto), so a non-empty SITEADD can be a placeholder. PARNO may carry stray leading or embedded whitespace (measured in Alcorn), so match it with LIKE or trim before an equality. Mailing address columns mapped: MAILADD1 is filled on 85.2% of rows (15,807). We read 25 rows on 2026-10-13; 22 were street-like (a house number or a PO Box), under the 90% the atlas requires. A second sample of 50 rows from a different FID window came back 45 of 50, so the columns are mapped. The city, state and ZIP columns are mapped with it. CORS: the server echoes any request Origin, so browser tools call it directly. License: the portal item declares none and the MARIS disclaimer (the licenseUrl) states no redistribution or attribution terms; the data is public, free and keyless.

Served by the MARIS/MDEQ 2024 statewide cadastral layer (East half, MS_MDEQPARCELS_East_2024 MapServer layer 0 on gis.mississippi.edu), compiled from the county tax assessors' rolls and republished by MARIS; credit the Wayne County Tax Assessor's office and MARIS/MDEQ. The layer carries all 44 eastern counties (1,127,050 parcels), so every attribute search here is scoped with STCNTYFIPS = '28153' (17,564 parcels read 2026-10-12). Informational only and not a legal record: verify with the Wayne County Tax Assessor, whose roll is the authoritative source. The layer refuses pagination (any resultRecordCount or resultOffset returns HTTP 200 with error 400 "Pagination is not supported.") and answers at most 2,000 rows per request, setting exceededTransferLimit on a cut; orderByFields and returnDistinctValues are ignored without an error, outStatistics fails, and returnCountOnly, returnIdsOnly and objectIds work. A FID equality or a read scoped by FIPS plus a FID range answers in 70 to 550 ms, and a count over a FIPS-plus-FID range in about 1.1 s. A PARNO equality or any other non-FID predicate scans the whole statewide layer and takes 1.3 s to more than 20 s, more on the first query after hours idle, so scope anything else with STCNTYFIPS plus a FID range or objectIds. The server rejects FID BETWEEN (HTTP 200 with error 400 "Failed to execute query."); write the range as FID >= a AND FID <= b. OWNNAME and SITEADD are each filled on 100.0% of rows (17,562), with SCITY, SSTATE and SZIP beside them. Across the statewide layer SITEADD carries the vacant-land placeholders '0' and '0 <STREET>' on some rows (about 48% in Hancock, 26% in Lamar, 11% in DeSoto), so a non-empty SITEADD can be a placeholder. PARNO may carry stray leading or embedded whitespace (measured in Alcorn), so match it with LIKE or trim before an equality. Mailing columns not mapped; the owner mailing address capability record says why. CORS: the server echoes any request Origin, so browser tools call it directly.
